descriptionByLocale.it:
Designazione Diventa parte del nostro dipartimento di tecnologia e mobilità ferroviaria. Progettiamo l'infrastruttura svizzera per le generazioni future. I nostri clienti sono compagnie ferroviarie, aeroporti e compagnie di trasporto svizzere. Con i nostri progetti creiamo la base per aumentare il trasporto passeggeri e merci entro il 2050. Per i nostri clienti sviluppiamo la soluzione tecnica dal pre-progetto alla messa in servizio. CONSTRUZIONE EUR:IN FAHRSTROM 40-100% - DOGANALI ANNI: - Trattamento tecnico dei progetti attuali in tutta la Svizzera - Pianificazione dei sistemi via cavo (mazzoncini, fondazioni, filo di contatto) - Impianti di propulsione in loco - Lavori di pianificazione indipendenti con strumenti di pianificazione specifici (incluso FACDA) - Partecipazione alla gestione del campo - Supporto per i project manager nell'elaborazione dei progetti HER CHANCEN: - Progetti emozionanti e versatili in team interdisciplinari. Essi progettano l'infrastruttura ferroviaria del futuro attraverso la cooperazione su progetti come il tunnel di base di Lötschberg - Lavoro flessibile/lavoro mobile (Home Office) - Possibilità di sviluppo versatili (ad esempio a / per l'ingegnere del progetto:in) - Partecipazione alla formazione individuale IHR PROFIL: - Interessi nella gestione dei progetti nel campo del flusso web - L'insegnamento professionale completo come artista grafico:in / designer:in - Un ulteriore sviluppo come tecnico: in HF sarebbe vantaggioso - Esperienza con AutoCAD o simili sistemi CAD - Buona conoscenza del tedesco, la conoscenza di altre lingue nazionali sono vantaggiose - Sono interessati a nuovi argomenti che derivano dalla digitalizzazione (ad esempio: BIM pianificazione) Fai parte della storia di successo AFRY!
• Offriamo spazio di progettazione e auto-responsabilità, ambiente di lavoro collegiale e internazionale, condizioni di lavoro contemporaneo, modelli di lavoro flessibili, benefici sociali sopra la media, possibilità di sviluppo attraenti e generosa partecipazione all'ÖV Abo così come una semi-tassa in modo da poter raggiungere i nostri moderni edifici di ufficio in una posizione centrale. Non vediamo l'ora della tua applicazione online! Descrizione della Società AFRY offre servizi di ingegneria, project management e consulenza che supportano la transizione energetica e la trasformazione industriale e rafforzano la resilienza sociale. Con 18.000 esperti in tutto il mondo, combiniamo la portata globale con competenze locali e conoscenze del settore complete per sostenere il futuro delle generazioni future. Creare un futuro Ulteriori informazioni All'AFRY facciamo cambiamenti in tutto quello che facciamo. Perché il cambiamento nasce solo quando si incontrano idee coraggiose. Se lavoriamo insieme con successo, siamo innovativi e prendiamo angoli diversi. E' cosi' che formiamo il futuro. Siamo attivamente alla ricerca di candidati qualificati che vogliono diventare parte dei nostri team inclusi e diversi in tutto il mondo. Unisciti a noi per accelerare la transizione verso un futuro più sostenibile.
descriptionByLocale.en:
Description Become part of our railway technology & mobility department. We plan the Swiss infrastructure for future generations. Our customers are Swiss railway companies, airports and transport companies. With our projects we create the basis for increasing passenger and freight transport by 2050. descriptionByLocale.en:
Senior Consultant – Asset Management Systems (m/f/d) 80-100% – Zürich/Basel — AFRY, Basel.

Job Description
If you are passionate about infrastructure, consulting and helping clients make better long term investment decisions, we invite you to take on responsibility with us as:
SENIOR CONSULTANT – ASSET MANAGEMENT SYSTEMS (M/F/D) 80-100% - ZÜRICH / BASEL
YOUR TASKS:
We are looking for strong competencies in a selection of these areas; no candidate is expected to meet every requirement.

• Lead individual project workstreams and independently structure analyses, approaches and client deliverables

• Prepare and deliver high-quality client presentations, management reports, workshops and executive decision-making materials

• Support the preparation of proposals, tenders, business cases and commercial opportunities across rail, energy and critical infrastructure sectors

• Conduct strategic and technical analyses related to infrastructure asset management, maintenance strategies, renewal planning and investment prioritisation

• Apply AFRY asset-management methodologies, frameworks and digital tools within client organisations

• Facilitate client workshops, interviews and stakeholder discussions, translating client requirements into actionable solutions

• Translate complex technical, operational and analytical findings into clear recommendations for senior management and decision-makers

• Contribute to the development of our asset-management software suite and digital solutions by identifying client needs and supporting implementation activities

• Support quantitative modelling, forecasting and scenario analysis related to asset condition, resilience, lifecycle costs and investment planning

• Coach and support junior consultants and analysts as part of project delivery teams

• Build trusted relationships with clients and contribute to the growth of AFRY’s Asset Management Systems business
You will have the opportunity to join AFRY trainee events and learning programmes across Europe and Scandinavia and collaborate with colleagues from multiple countries. In the short term, you will work on projects across Europe, in the long term, you will have the opportunity to work on international projects
YOUR PROFILE:
We are looking for strong competencies in a selection of these areas; no candidate is expected to meet every requirement.

• University degree in engineering, economics, business administration, applied mathematics, data science, physics, computer science or a related discipline

• 4–8 years of professional experience in management consulting, infrastructure, asset management, engineering, analytics or related industries

• Experience preparing and delivering client presentations, leading workshops and developing proposals and strategic recommendations

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to structure complex topics and communicate them clearly

• Experience managing workstreams and coordinating stakeholders in multidisciplinary project environments

• Understanding of infrastructure sectors such as rail, energy, utilities or other asset-intensive industries

• Knowledge of asset management, lifecycle planning, maintenance strategies or infrastructure investment decision-making

• Experience with data analysis, quantitative modelling or digital solutions is advantageous

• Familiarity with asset-management frameworks and standards such as ISO 55000 is advantageous

• Business development experience, including proposal writing, tender support and client engagement, is highly desirable

• Strong communication and presentation skills with confidence interacting with senior stakeholders

• Fluent German and English; additional languages are an advantage

• Open, entrepreneurial and solution-oriented mindset with willingness to travel when required

YOUR OPPORTUNITIES:

• Work at leading infrastructure asset management, combining consulting, digital solutions and domain expertise

• Take ownership of client-facing workstreams with significant responsibility and visibility

• Contribute to strategic projects across rail, energy and critical infrastructure sectors throughout Europe

• Collaborate with a multidisciplinary team of consultants, engineers, software developers and data scientists

• Shape the development of innovative asset-management methodologies and digital solutions

• Join a dynamic, international and fast-growing team with strong growth ambitions and a clear mandate for sustainability and value creation
Become part of the AFRY success story! We offer creative freedom and personal responsibility, a supportive and international working environment, up-to-date employment terms, flexible working arrangements, above-average perks, attractive development opportunities and generous contributions towards your public transport passes as well as a Half-Fare card, so that you can easily reach our modern office buildings in central locations.
We look forward to receiving your online application!

Company Description
AFRY provides engineering, project management, and advisory services that enable the energy and industrial transition and strengthen resilience in society.
With 18,000 experts worldwide, we combine a global reach with local insights and deep sector knowledge to make a lasting impact for generations to come.
Making Future
In alignment with AFRY’s strategy to accelerate sustainability, strengthen digital capabilities and safeguard critical infrastructure, our Asset Management Systems team operates at the interface between data, technology and asset-intensive portfolios.
We focus on rail, energy and other critical infrastructure sectors, where resilient, efficient and future-proof asset management is essential.
We are a hybrid consulting and digital solutions team focused on infrastructure asset management, decision-support systems and strategic advisory. We help infrastructure owners and operators develop data-driven strategies for complex asset portfolios, delivering integrated solutions from asset management assessments and portfolio condition evaluations to long term maintenance, renewal and investment planning.
A core part of our offering is an asset-management software suite deployed by infrastructure managers across Europe, supporting condition evaluation, resilience simulations, deterioration modelling, lifecycle cost forecasting, scenario-based CAPEX/OPEX planning, backlog management, benchmarking and advanced asset prioritisation.

Additional Information
Our central office is based in Zürich/Basel, offering flexibility for self-organization. We look forward to receiving your online application.

At AFRY, we engineer change in everything we do. Change happens when brave ideas come together. When we collaborate, innovate technology, and embrace challenging points of view. That’s how we're making future. We are actively looking for qualified candidates to join our inclusive and diverse teams across the globe. Join us in accelerating the transition towards a sustainable future.

• L'expérience de l'analyse des données, de la modélisation quantitative ou des solutions numériques est avantageuse
• La connaissance des cadres et normes de gestion des actifs tels que ISO 55000 est avantageuse

• Des compétences solides en communication et en présentation avec confiance interagissent avec les principaux intervenants

• Une mentalité ouverte, entrepreneuriale et orientée vers la solution avec la volonté de voyager au besoin · Vos possibilités :

• Rejoignez une équipe dynamique, internationale et en croissance rapide avec de fortes ambitions de croissance et un mandat clair pour la durabilité et la création de valeur Désignation de l'entreprise AFRY est une société européenne leader dans les services d'ingénierie, de conception et de conseil avec une présence mondiale. En tant qu'entreprise, nous menons la transition vers une société plus durable. Nous sommes une équipe de 18 000 experts dédiés dans les domaines de l'infrastructure, de l'industrie, de l'énergie et de la numérisation, en créant des solutions durables pour les générations futures. Débloquer la transition. Conformément à la stratégie d'AFRY, qui vise à accélérer la durabilité, à renforcer les capacités numériques et à protéger les infrastructures essentielles, notre équipe de systèmes de gestion d'actifs fonctionne à l'interface entre les données, la technologie et les portefeuilles à forte intensité d'actifs. Nous nous concentrons sur les secteurs du rail, de l'énergie et d'autres infrastructures essentielles, où une gestion des biens résiliente, efficace et à l'épreuve du futur est essentielle. Nous sommes une équipe hybride de conseil et de solutions numériques axée sur la gestion des biens d'infrastructure, les systèmes d'aide à la décision et les conseils stratégiques. Une partie essentielle de notre offre est une suite logicielle de gestion d'actifs déployée par les gestionnaires d'infrastructures dans toute l'Europe, supportant l'évaluation des conditions, les simulations de résilience, la modélisation de la détérioration, la prévision des coûts du cycle de vie, la planification CAPEX/OPEX basée sur des scénarios, la gestion de l'arriéré, l'étalonnage et la priorisation avancée des actifs. Informations complémentaires Notre bureau central est basé à Zurich/Basel, offrant une flexibilité pour l'auto-organisation. Nous sommes impatients de recevoir votre demande en ligne. Chez AFRY, nous réalisons des changements dans tout ce que nous faisons. Le changement se produit lorsque des idées courageuses se réunissent. Lorsque nous collaborons, innovons en technologie et adoptons des points de vue difficiles. C'est comme ça qu'on fait l'avenir. Nous cherchons activement des candidats qualifiés pour rejoindre nos équipes inclusives et diversifiées partout dans le monde. Rejoignez-nous pour accélérer la transition vers un avenir durable.
